NEEDS_FIX: YES
<assessment>SOURCE is one street-level oblique view showing the tower’s front and right elevations, its stepped connection to the lower left block, planted terraces, pale projecting grid, recessed glazing and darker lower facade zone. CURRENT 10–12 show these same landmarks from different camera elevations; CURRENT 4–9 clarify their geometry. The principal remaining differences are facade subdivision and the low-wing terrace enclosure. Exact dimensions, hidden connections and rear elevations are unverified; these images do not establish slab penetration or floating railings. External context has visibly been removed as requested. This does not resolve the conflicting older neighbor-retention intent, and restoration is not requested.</assessment>
<issue priority="1" view="front">problem: SOURCE’s highest tower section reads approximately six front bays and five right-end bays; CURRENT 4, 7 and 10–12 retain five and four. The wider modules change the opening rhythm and placement of solid panels and outdoor recesses.
action: Record the unresolved bay and opening arrangement for a separately scoped facade correction. Adjust affected subdivisions locally when authorized, preserving completed loggia returns and recessed glazing. The latest instruction to retain the facade does not authorize this correction now.</issue>
<issue priority="2" view="oblique">problem: SOURCE’s terraces above the low wing alternate with recessed, partly enclosed outdoor spaces. CURRENT 10–12 predominantly show projecting stacked trays with continuous glass edges, changing the visible relationship between terraces and enclosed rooms.
action: Locally correct the source-visible terrace setbacks, enclosure returns and perimeter connections while retaining supported planting zones. Verify slab-to-wall joints in close views; the supplied views do not prove penetration. This remains outside the current preservation scope.</issue>
<keep>
Visible side and top returns of the completed recessed tower loggias.
Pale structural-frame finish.
Darker lower-facade material zone.
</keep>
<review_requirements>[
  {
    "feature_id": "terraced_apartment/visible_facades/grid_and_glazing",
    "relation": "unchanged",
    "prior_requirement_id": "b97f136d89960e7d58a96388",
    "desired_state": "Articulate the source-visible tower and stepped-wing elevations with a pale projecting structural grid, recessed glazing, aligned floor and bay divisions, transparent street-level frontage and the darker lower facade zone.",
    "source_ref": "inputs/reference/4e52d9a057-source-target.png",
    "model_revisions": {"terraced_apartment": 11},
    "evidence": "SOURCE最高塔段主立面约6跨、右端面约5跨；CURRENT 4、7、10–12仍为5跨和4跨，格位、开口及实墙排列差异未解决。已完成凹阳台的后退玻璃、侧返和顶面应保留；精确格位及隐藏连接仍有不确定性。最新指令要求主体形体立面保持，本项记录未解决差异，不授权本轮修改。"
  },
  {
    "feature_id": "terraced_apartment/stepped_wing/terrace_assemblies",
    "relation": "unchanged",
    "prior_requirement_id": "065e3e0f9d79b1371da800d4",
    "desired_state": "Form the source-visible setback terraces with connected surfaces, perimeter edges, recessed outdoor bays and planting zones, including those above the low wing; keep terrace slabs clear of adjoining enclosure walls.",
    "source_ref": "inputs/reference/4e52d9a057-source-target.png",
    "model_revisions": {"terraced_apartment": 11},
    "evidence": "SOURCE低翼上方可见交错退台及嵌入体量的户外空间；CURRENT 10–12仍主要表现为外挑托盘和连续玻璃边，退进及围合关系尚未对应。CURRENT 8不能证明隐藏板墙连接正确，也不足以判定穿墙。最新指令要求主体及建筑绿化保持，本项继续未解决，不授权本轮修改。"
  }
]</review_requirements>
<requirement_resolutions>[
  {
    "feature_id": "terraced_apartment/scene/external_context_removal",
    "prior_requirement_id": "12f8e0ae8313c2ab3751dd56",
    "status": "resolved",
    "source_ref": "inputs/reference/4e52d9a057-source-target.png",
    "model_revisions": {"terraced_apartment": 11},
    "evidence": "CURRENT 4–12显示独立邻楼、道路、轨道、架空线及街树已移除，主体、阳台及建筑附属绿化仍在。此项移除结果满足最新明确指令；仅结清环境移除要求，不代表旧邻楼保留要求已被有效supersedes或已解决，也不要求恢复邻楼。"
  }
]</requirement_resolutions>
